digest.component_or_area: terraform-drift workflow and Gerrit CI integration
propositions: terraform-drift.yml does not run on Gerrit changes because it only triggers on pull_request, push to main, or schedule; Gerrit changes flow through the GitHub mirror, so drift is never checked before submit
a change can receive Verified +1 and land with unapplied terraform resources because the drift check runs post-merge on the push event, after the change is already committed to main
the 34cd change added CloudWatch metric alarm resource declarations to HCL that were never applied to AWS, causing the post-merge terraform-drift run to fail and main to go red
the gap exists because reviewers interpret a passing Verified gate as proof that infrastructure is live, when the gate only proves code builds and tests pass, not that terraform has been applied

two fix options exist: either run drift checks pre-submit with special logic to exclude the change's own additions, or add explicit apply attestation to landing requirements and document terraform apply as part of the landing process
